findings.evidence: Orchestration defect, closed across revisions 1-3: review 1 specified the gate as a list of relation spellings instead of a fail-closed allowlist, and each pass found new bypass shapes (RF1, RF6, RF8). Final gate verified by r4-reviewer-plants.txt. Lesson: specify detectors as allowlists from the start.

RF9: the audit passed every static check yet raised 22023 live (aclexplode on an empty ACL array). The orchestrator hotfixed N5 mid-procedure (kickoff 18.3); both live grids then ran. A static single-statement check cannot prove a catalog query runs.

Kickoff F9 materialised (19c-manual-checks.txt): on sign-out useNotifications.ts calls fetchAll() before its userId guard, so one anonymous read now returns 401 and logs [notifications] fetch failed. No functional break. Out of 881 scope; filed as Task 883 (Sprint 80).
